_about: Bot Trading League broker fee table (season 1, trading-only). Real published fees of Canadian online platforms, used by the league engine to SIMULATE fills. No real accounts or orders. Values marked estimate:true are NOT published by the platform; the note says how the number was chosen.
assumptions: Every bot has ONE CAD cash pool. Each holding records the platform it was bought on and must be sold on that platform.

No USD sub-accounts: every buy of a USD asset converts CAD->USD and every sale converts USD->CAD at the platform's FX conversion cost (as in a plain CAD account). Norbert's gambit / journaling is not simulated.
Market orders only (immediate fill). Taker fees apply on maker/taker exchanges. Limit orders are not simulated.
Base retail tier for every platform (no volume discounts, no paid subscriptions such as Questrade Plus, Kraken+, Coinbase One, Wealthsimple Premium).

Stock/ETF fills: last trade price from Yahoo Finance +/- the modeled 0.05% spread/slippage (estimate, Yahoo does not give a reliable live bid/ask). Option fills: Yahoo option-chain ask (buy) / bid (sell), quotes may be delayed ~15 min. Crypto fills: the venue's live best ask/bid from its public API where one exists.
GST/HST on commissions, regulatory pass-through fees (SEC/FINRA/CAT, exchange/ECN, clearing) are not simulated; they are fractions of a cent to a few cents on these order sizes.
stock_spread_note: ESTIMATE: modeled half-spread/slippage on stock & ETF fills because the quote source gives last price, not live bid/ask.

fx.note: 1.5% fee applied to WSII corporate rate: buy rate = rate/(1-0.015), sell rate = rate*(1-0.015) (Wealthsimple's own worked example).

unsupported.tsx_options: No public real-time/delayed quote feed for Montreal Exchange options is available to the engine, so Canadian-listed options cannot be simulated.
unsupported.option_writing: Selling options to open (covered calls, cash-secured puts) is not simulated yet; only buying calls/puts and selling them back (long options).
unsupported.index_options: Index options (SPX, XSP, NDX, VIX...) are not supported.
unsupported.shorting_margin_leverage: No shorting, margin, leverage, futures, perps, CFDs or FX trading.
unsupported.leveraged_inverse_etfs: Leveraged and inverse ETFs/ETNs are rejected by the engine.
unsupported.mutual_funds_gics_bonds: Mutual funds, GICs, bonds and precious metals are not simulated.
unsupported.staking_lending: Staking, lending and other yield programs are not simulated.
